summary: Eagle Point Credit Co Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its conversion from a Delaware corporation to a Delaware Statutory Trust, effective May 22, 2026, along with a name change to Eagle Point Credit Company. Stockholder and board approvals were obtained. Each common and preferred share converts into corresponding beneficial interest shares. All tickers and exchange listings remain uninterrupted. No consideration, premium, or special distribution is involved. This is a structural reorganization, not a typical special situation. Watch for potential tax implications or operational changes post-conversion.
